description: Flunitrazepam is a long-acting benzodiazepine with strong sleep-inducing, calming, anti-anxiety and muscle-relaxing effects. In some countries, such as Australia, lower-dose forms (Hypnodorm) are prescribed for severe insomnia when other treatments have failed. Because it is very strong, stays in the body a long time, and has a high risk of misuse, it is strictly regulated and is not approved in the United States.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Flunitrazepam is a long-acting benzodiazepine with strong hypnotic, sedative, anxiolytic, and muscle relaxant effects. In some countries, such as Australia, lower-dose formulations (Hypnodorm) are prescribed for severe insomnia when other treatments have failed. Due to its potency, long half-life, and high risk for misuse, it is subject to strict regulation and is not approved in the United States.
